001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.pattern.format;
002
003import java.nio.charset.Charset;
004import java.time.Instant;
005import java.time.ZoneId;
006import java.util.function.Function;
007
008import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
009
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEncoder;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogOutput.OutputType;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider;
015import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProviderRef;
016import io.jstach.rainbowgum.ServiceRegistry;
017import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable;
018import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable.ConvertParameter;
019import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable.KeyParameter;
020import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable.PassThroughParameter;
021import io.jstach.rainbowgum.pattern.format.DefaultFormatterConfig.StandardPropertyFunction;
022import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider;
023import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator;
024import io.jstach.svc.ServiceProvider;
025
026/**
027 * Configures Logback style pattern encoders and offers provision with the URI scheme
028 * {@value PatternEncoder#PATTERN_SCHEME}.
029 *
030 * @see PatternEncoderBuilder
031 */
032@ServiceProvider(RainbowGumServiceProvider.class)
033public final class PatternConfigurator implements Configurator {
034
035        /**
036         * Property that will disable this configurator from replacing the default encoder
037         * with the pattern encoder. The default encoder is normally the TTLL encoder but if
038         * this configurator is loaded the pattern encoder will be used and if a no pattern is
039         * provided a default one is picked.
040         */
041        public static final String LOGGING_PATTERN_DISABLE_PROPERTY = LogProperties.ROOT_PREFIX + "pattern.disable";
042
043        /**
044         * For service loader to call.
045         */
046        public PatternConfigurator() {
047                // for service loader.
048        }
049
050        @Override
051        public int priority() {
052                return -1 << 2; // internal group 2
053        }
054
055        private static final String DEFAULT_PATTERN = """
056                        %cyan(%date{HH:mm:ss.SSS}) %clr([%thread]){faint} %highlight(%-5level){ERROR=red bold, INFO=blue bold, WARN=red} %magenta(%logger{36}) - %msg%n%ex""";
057
058        @Override
059        public boolean configure(LogConfig config, Pass pass) {
060                var services = config.serviceRegistry();
061                String n = ServiceRegistry.DEFAULT_SERVICE_NAME;
062                services.putIfAbsent(PatternRegistry.class, n, PatternRegistry::of);
063                services.putIfAbsent(PatternCompiler.class, n, () -> PatternCompiler.of(b -> {
064                }).provide(n, config));
065                config.encoderRegistry().register(PatternEncoder.PATTERN_SCHEME, new PatternEncoderProvider());
066                var disable = config.properties()
067                        .forKey(LOGGING_PATTERN_DISABLE_PROPERTY)
068                        .ofBoolean()
069                        .or(false)
070                        .validateNow(PatternConfigurator.class);
071                if (!disable) {
072                        config.encoderRegistry().setEncoderForOutputType(OutputType.CONSOLE_OUT, (name, c) -> {
073                                PatternEncoderBuilder b = new PatternEncoderBuilder(name);
074                                b.pattern(DEFAULT_PATTERN);
075                                b.fromProperties(c.properties());
076                                return b.build().provide(name, config);
077                        });
078                }
079                return true;
080        }
081
082        @LogConfigurable(name = "PatternEncoderBuilder", prefix = LogProperties.ENCODER_PREFIX)
083        static LogProvider<LogEncoder> provideEncoder(@KeyParameter String name, String pattern,
084                        @PassThroughParameter @Nullable PatternCompiler patternCompiler,
085                        @ConvertParameter("convertCharset") @Nullable Charset charset, @Nullable Integer maxBufferSize) {
086                return (n, config) -> {
087                        var compiler = patternCompiler;
088                        if (compiler == null) {
089                                compiler = PatternCompiler.of(b -> {
090                                }).provide(name, config);
091                        }
092                        var formatter = compiler.compile(pattern);
093                        var builder = LogEncoder.builder(formatter);
094                        if (charset != null) {
095                                builder.charset(charset);
096                        }
097                        if (maxBufferSize != null) {
098                                builder.maxBufferSize(maxBufferSize);
099                        }
100                        return builder.build().provide(n, config);
101                };
102        }
103
104        static Charset convertCharset(String charset) {
105                return Charset.forName(charset);
106        }
107
108        @LogConfigurable(name = "PatternConfigBuilder", prefix = PatternConfig.PATTERN_CONFIG_PREFIX)
109        static PatternConfig provideFormatterConfig(@KeyParameter String name, //
110                        @ConvertParameter("convertZoneId") @Nullable ZoneId zoneId, //
111                        @Nullable String lineSeparator, //
112                        @Nullable Boolean ansiDisabled, //
113                        @PassThroughParameter @Nullable Function<String, @Nullable String> propertyFunction, //
114                        @PassThroughParameter @Nullable Instant startTime, //
115                        @ConvertParameter("convertSequenceNumberStart") @Nullable Long sequenceNumberStart, //
116                        @ConvertParameter("convertAbbreviatorCache") PatternConfig.@Nullable CacheType abbreviatorCache) {
117                PatternConfig dc = PatternConfig.of();
118                ansiDisabled = ansiDisabled == null ? dc.ansiDisabled() : ansiDisabled;
119                lineSeparator = lineSeparator == null ? dc.lineSeparator() : lineSeparator;
120                zoneId = zoneId == null ? dc.zoneId() : zoneId;
121                propertyFunction = propertyFunction == null ? StandardPropertyFunction.INSTANCE : propertyFunction;
122                startTime = startTime == null ? Instant.now() : startTime;
123                long sequenceNumberStart_ = sequenceNumberStart == null ? dc.sequenceNumberStart() : sequenceNumberStart;
124                abbreviatorCache = abbreviatorCache == null ? dc.abbreviatorCache() : abbreviatorCache;
125                return new SimpleFormatterConfig(zoneId, lineSeparator, ansiDisabled, propertyFunction, startTime,
126                                sequenceNumberStart_, abbreviatorCache);
127
128        }
129
130        static Long convertSequenceNumberStart(String s) {
131                return Long.valueOf(s);
132        }
133
134        static PatternConfig.CacheType convertAbbreviatorCache(String s) {
135                return PatternConfig.CacheType.parse(s);
136        }
137
138        static ZoneId convertZoneId(String zoneId) {
139                return ZoneId.of(zoneId);
140        }
141
142}
143
144record PatternEncoderProvider() implements LogEncoder.EncoderProvider {
145
146        @Override
147        public LogProvider<LogEncoder> provide(LogProviderRef ref) {
148                return (name, config) -> {
149                        PatternEncoderBuilder b = new PatternEncoderBuilder(name);
150                        b.fromProperties(config.properties(), ref);
151                        return b.build().provide(name, config);
152                };
153        }
154
155}
